en: A vintage postcard featuring a black-and-white photograph of a crowded beach promenade, with people dressed in early 20th-century attire. The beach is filled with bathing machines, people strolling, and sitting on benches. The lower section of the front contains handwritten text and printed details identifying the location as 'Boulogne-sur-Mer.' The reverse side shows a French stamp, a postmark from Boulogne-sur-Mer (dated 26-8-02), and is addressed in Swedish to 'Fröken Camille Melén,' in Skara, Sweden.
